mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM prj.prj WHERE prj_id=#{id})

SELECT a.asgn_id,a.dev_id,d.dev_nm,calendar.work_ym,COALESCE(m.mm_qty,0::numeric) AS mm_qty FROM asgn.asgn a JOIN mst.dev d ON d.dev_id=a.dev_id CROSS JOIN ( SELECT to_char(month_day,'YYYY-MM') AS work_ym FROM generate_series(CAST(#{start} AS timestamp),CAST(#{end} AS timestamp),interval '1 month') month_day ) calendar LEFT JOIN asgn.asgn_mth m ON m.asgn_id=a.asgn_id AND m.work_ym=calendar.work_ym AND m.work_ym BETWEEN #{firstMonth} AND #{lastMonth} WHERE a.prj_id=#{id} AND a.asgn_stts_cd != 'CANCELLED' AND a.bgn_dt <= #{end} AND a.end_dt >= #{start} ORDER BY d.dev_nm,a.asgn_id,calendar.work_ym
